privacy.title: Who we are
paragraphs: DreamCabs KMR Private Limited provides the DreamCabs Customer app, DreamCabs Driver app and related booking services. This policy explains how we use personal data across these services. Contact dreamcabs2025@gmail.com for privacy questions or requests.
We do not sell personal data or location records to advertisers or data brokers.

privacy.title: Information we collect and why
paragraphs: Account information includes your name, verified phone number, account identifier and any email address, profile photo, birth date or address you provide. We use it to maintain your account, check eligibility, communicate with you and provide rides. An email address and a saved account address are optional in customer profile completion.

Booking records include pickup and destination, route, trip times, seats, passenger details, ratings, payment method, transaction references, deposits, refunds and invoices. If you book for another person, we also receive the name and phone number you enter for that passenger. Give that person this privacy notice and obtain their permission before submitting their details.

Driver information includes vehicle and registration details, verification documents and their entered fields, approval status, earnings, wallet and subscription records. Where payout setup is used, we receive bank or UPI details and identity information such as PAN. These support verification, operation and settlement.

We receive emergency contact names and numbers that you choose to save, and information you send to support. Device model, operating system, app version, device identifiers and push tokens may be collected for login, account security, troubleshooting and notification delivery. Notification permission is separate from basic device information.

privacy.title: Location and trip tracking
paragraphs: Customer app: with permission, we use location while the app is in use to help select pickups, find rides and check pickup status. Fixed-route pickup checks use foreground location. Keep the pickup screen open for fresh updates. You can enter or select a pickup manually; denying location may limit automatic pickup checks.

Driver app: after the in-app disclosure and your permission, DreamCabs collects and sends precise location while you are online or working on a ride, including in the background when the app is minimized or the screen is locked. We use it for nearby ride requests, pickup checks and live trip tracking visible to your passengers and DreamCabs administrators. Going offline stops dispatch tracking; an active ride can have its own tracking until it ends. Signing out stops all app location watchers.

Location records can include coordinates, timestamps, accuracy, speed and direction. You can revoke location permission in your device settings. Device settings, connectivity and battery restrictions can affect tracking; location and arrival estimates are not guarantees.

privacy.title: Your permission choices
paragraphs: You can sign in without granting contacts, camera, photo-library or notification permission. We request location when a location feature needs it. Camera access is for taking photos; system file or photo pickers let you choose an existing image for upload. We do not need access to your entire photo library.

Contact selection is optional and helps you save an emergency contact; manual entry is available. We do not upload your entire address book. Push notifications provide ride and account updates. You can change these permissions in device settings. This release does not provide a voice-booking or audio-recording service.

privacy.title: Who receives information
paragraphs: Ride participants receive the information needed to coordinate a booking: names, contact phone numbers, pickup and destination details, and driver/vehicle information. Phone calls use the provided number; we do not promise call masking. If you share a trip link, anyone who receives the link may access the trip information it exposes until it expires or is revoked. Share links only with people you trust.

We use service providers for hosting, communications, mapping and payments. These include Google Maps/Places for map and place queries, MSG91 for SMS verification, Firebase Authentication where that login method is used, Firebase Cloud Messaging for push delivery and Razorpay for payment processing. Map providers receive relevant map/place requests; verification providers receive the details needed to verify a phone or account; messaging providers receive delivery tokens and notification content; payment providers receive the details needed to process payments. Our Reverb service carries live updates; using a Pusher-compatible client does not mean Pusher hosts those updates.

Providers may process information on infrastructure in India or other countries under their service arrangements. We require providers handling data for us to protect it consistently with this policy and use it for the contracted service. We may disclose relevant information when required by law, to resolve a dispute or to protect users from fraud or harm.

The in-app SOS sends an alert and available location/trip details to DreamCabs administrators. It does not automatically notify police or saved emergency contacts, and does not guarantee a response. Contact local emergency services directly for urgent assistance.

privacy.title: Security and retention
paragraphs: Our production API and live-update connections use HTTPS/TLS. Access to account and verification data is restricted through authentication and permissions; selected payout identity and account fields are encrypted by the backend. No service can guarantee absolute security.

Account, saved-contact, booking and location information is used while your account and service relationship remain active. Account deletion removes the account and its associated operational records and uploads through our deletion flow. Independent accounting and settlement records, payment-provider records and data needed for a legal obligation or unresolved dispute may be retained for the applicable required period. They are not used to reactivate your account. Contact us for the categories and retention requirements applicable to your request.

Deletion of a DreamCabs account does not recall messages already delivered to another person or erase records a payment provider must keep for its own obligations. Contact us to coordinate related provider-data requests and to understand any backup, financial or legal retention exception. We do not promise that every record is stored only in India or that all record types use one encryption algorithm.

privacy.title: Delete your account or request data help
paragraphs: In either app, open More and choose Delete account. Review the explanation and confirm. This deletes the DreamCabs account for that phone number, including both customer and driver access if they share the account. All account sessions are revoked. This cannot be undone; creating a new account does not restore deleted information. Account deletion does not itself request a ride refund or settle outstanding money; contact support about unresolved payments.

The app confirms success only after account deletion and the required upload/identity cleanup complete. If cleanup fails, it shows an error so you can retry or contact support. We do not use a separate deletion OTP or promise a scheduled 30-day purge in this flow.

You can also request deletion without installing or signing into the app: email dreamcabs2025@gmail.com with the subject Account Deletion Request, identify the customer/driver account and provide the registered phone number with country code. You do not need a registered email address. We will verify ownership through an accessible method before acting. Never send your password or an OTP by email. If you cannot access the registered number, tell support so an alternative verification method can be arranged.

Use the same contact to request access, correction, an explanation of retention, withdrawal of optional consent or help exercising applicable privacy rights. You can edit available profile fields and saved contacts in the app. For information that cannot be changed there, contact support. Requests requiring manual processing will receive an explanation of the next steps and expected completion time.

privacy.title: Eligibility and children
paragraphs: Accounts are intended for people aged 18 or older. A parent or authorized adult may book for an accompanied minor and is responsible for that booking. We do not offer independent child accounts. If you believe a child has registered, contact us to request review and removal of the account.

privacy.title: Contact and policy updates
paragraphs: Privacy and grievance contact: DreamCabs KMR Private Limited, Legal & Compliance Cell, Kupwara Main Market / Transport Yard, Kupwara, Jammu & Kashmir, India 193222. Email: dreamcabs2025@gmail.com.

The version date identifies this notice. We will publish changes here and provide additional notice or request new consent where required. The same current policy is available on our website and within the apps.

terms.title: Using DreamCabs
paragraphs: These terms govern the DreamCabs Customer app, DreamCabs Driver app and related services provided by DreamCabs KMR Private Limited. By using the service you agree to these terms. Our Privacy Policy describes how personal data is handled.

DreamCabs connects passengers with independent driver-partners for private, fixed-route and shuttle transport. Drivers operate their vehicles and are responsible for providing the booked transport safely and lawfully. These terms do not remove rights or responsibilities that applicable law makes mandatory.

terms.title: Accounts and eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old to hold an account. Minors may travel when accompanied by a parent or authorized adult who books the ride. Provide accurate account and passenger details, protect your login codes and do not share your account. Obtain permission before providing another person's contact details.

terms.title: Bookings and fares
paragraphs: Available routes, seats, vehicle types and service areas are shown in the app. Private fares may involve an offer and acceptance; fixed-route and shuttle bookings use the displayed route/seat price. Availability and estimated arrival times can change. Review the booking details and total before confirming or paying.

Use the payment methods shown for the booking. A cash ride may require an online booking deposit; the remaining amount is payable to the driver. The online deposit forms part of the fare, not a second fare. Review any displayed taxes, extra charges, tolls and parking obligations. Voice booking is not available in this release.

terms.title: Cancellation, no-show and refunds
paragraphs: There is no universal three-minute free-cancellation window or flat cancellation fee across DreamCabs products. Review the cancellation information shown for your ride. Private cancellation may become unavailable when the driver is close to pickup or the ride has progressed beyond the cancellable stage.

Private and shuttle rides: where a customer cancellation is permitted before driver arrival, the cancellation charge is the configured percentage of the full fare, limited to the amount already paid online. The remaining online payment is refundable. After arrival or a customer no-show, the online payment may be forfeited. The online payment means the full fare for an online booking or the deposit for a cash booking.

Fixed-route seats: a permitted cancellation before the vehicle reaches your pickup is eligible for a refund of the online payment. After pickup arrival, boarding or a customer no-show, that payment is not refundable under the normal cancellation rules. Waiting/no-show windows depend on the route and city configuration.

When cancellation is caused by driver failure, the operator or the system, the applicable refund process returns the collected online payment for the affected booking. Refund requests can remain pending or require support if the payment provider fails. Any cash already paid to a driver requires separate resolution; the gateway cannot refund cash it did not collect.

Refunds are returned through the original payment process where supported. Bank/provider posting times vary; an approved or requested refund is not the same as money received. Contact dreamcabs2025@gmail.com with the booking ID for failed refunds, duplicate charges or service disputes. No instant wallet credit or fixed bank settlement time is guaranteed. These rules do not limit statutory remedies.

terms.title: Safety and respectful conduct
paragraphs: Wear seatbelts, follow safety instructions and treat passengers, drivers and staff respectfully. Harassment, violence, discrimination, fraud and driving under the influence are prohibited. Drivers must not operate when fatigued or unfit to drive.

SOS alerts DreamCabs administrators with available trip/location information. It does not automatically contact police or your saved emergency contacts, and delivery or response is not guaranteed. Contact local emergency services directly when urgent assistance is needed. Do not rely on the app as an emergency-response service.

Trip sharing depends on network and location availability. Share tracking links only with trusted people. We do not promise continuous monitoring of every ride or automatic enforcement of driver duty/rest periods.

terms.title: Driver responsibilities and commercial terms
paragraphs: Drivers must hold valid licences, vehicle permits, registration, insurance and other documents required for the service they operate. Submit accurate verification documents and keep them current. Follow traffic rules and agreed route stops, maintain a roadworthy vehicle and honor accepted bookings. Approval of an upload is not a substitute for complying with transport requirements.

Driver-partners operate independently. Applicable commission, wallet requirements and any paid plan are shown in the driver app. A plan may change the commission charged for transport bookings; review its price, duration, renewal setting and cancellation options before purchase. Turning off renewal does not itself refund a current plan or return a wallet balance. Contact support about a disputed charge or outstanding settlement.

Driver earnings and amounts due are recorded through the platform's settlement process. Do not assume that every digital fare is automatically paid to your bank each day. Check your settlement records and contact support for payout status. Account deletion does not waive money owed by either party.

terms.title: Account deletion and restrictions
paragraphs: Open More > Delete account in either app and confirm the stated scope. Deletion removes the shared DreamCabs account, including both customer and driver access for the same account. Review unresolved bookings, refunds and settlements before confirming; deletion does not itself cancel a ride through the refund process. Email dreamcabs2025@gmail.com to request deletion without the app or for help resolving an account issue.

Our Privacy Policy explains associated-data deletion, verification and retention exceptions. We may restrict access for fraud, unsafe conduct or violations of these terms, subject to applicable law. Contact support to dispute a restriction.

terms.title: Service interruptions and liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by applicable law, DreamCabs is not liable for indirect, incidental, punitive or consequential loss arising from use of the platform. Nothing in these terms excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.
Weather, road closures, network failures, natural disasters and other events outside reasonable control can disrupt service. Contact support about an affected booking or any refund due.

terms.title: Applicable law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes are subject to the competent courts in Jammu & Kashmir, subject to any mandatory jurisdiction or consumer-protection rights under applicable law. Contact support first so we can attempt to resolve the issue.

terms.title: Contact and changes
paragraphs: Support and grievance contact: DreamCabs KMR Private Limited, Legal & Compliance Cell, Kupwara Main Market / Transport Yard, Kupwara, Jammu & Kashmir, India 193222. Email dreamcabs2025@gmail.com. Include the booking ID where relevant and never disclose passwords or login OTPs.

We may update these terms. The current version is published on the website and in the apps; material changes will be communicated as required. Future features described elsewhere are not included in the service until they are available in the app.
